title: Communications Officer
description:
Role: Communications Officer

Sector: Public Sector

Duration: Interim 6 Months

Location: Bristol

Salary: £23.50 PAYE per hour

Sellick Partnership is currently recruiting for an experienced Officer to join our client based in Bristol. This role is offered on a full time, hybrid role with a minimum of 3 days a week in the office.

The Communications Officer will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong stakeholder relationships, supporting senior leadership engagement, monitoring external developments, and ensuring insights are effectively shared across the organisation.

The duties of the Communications Officer will include;
- Leading the coordination and delivery of a programme of stakeholder engagement activity, including senior leadership visits and meetings
- Supporting the planning and delivery of online and in-person events for senior external audiences Building and maintaining productive relationships with a wide range of external organisations and stakeholders
- Producing high-quality briefings for senior leaders ahead of meetings, events and stakeholder engagements
- Monitoring parliamentary and policy developments, providing concise summaries and insight to internal colleagues
- Supporting the preparation of evidence, briefing materials and background information for senior leaders
- Developing and improving systems and processes for managing stakeholder intelligence and engagement activity
- Creating engaging internal and external communications, including blogs, briefings and updates.
- Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the wider team

The Communications Officer will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a similar role
- Previous experience within the public sector
- Experience preparing briefings, reports, correspondence or communications for senior audiences.
- Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams and functions

The Communications and Engagement Specialist will need to have excellent communication skills and effectively be able to communicate to stakeholders of all levels. Furthermore, the ideal candidate will have an impeccable eye for detail and accuracy to ensure all workload is carried out effectively and efficiently. They will also need to able to prioritise their workload and be efficient and effective to meet unpredictable deadlines and deal with conflicting demands, whilst working in a high-pressured environment.

Our client is hoping to have the Communications Officer in the role as soon as possible, therefore if you believe your experience meets the criteria above, please contact Charlotte Broomfield by Monday 7 September by 5pm by submitted your CV directly.

Sellick Partnership is proud to be an inclusive and accessible recruitment business and we support applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Please note, our advertisements use years' experience, hourly rates, and salary levels purely as a guide and we assess applications based on the experience and skills evidenced on the CV. For information on how your personal details may be used by Sellick Partnership, please review our data processing notice on our website.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
Ecommerce Manager

The role: This is a hands-on trading role.

Reporting to the Managing Director, you will own the day-to-day commercial performance of the brand's Shopify store - running the weekly trading rhythm, shipping site changes and improving conversion week by week - while delivering a customer experience that reflects the brand's brand values.

You will work alongside our Marketing, Merchandising, Product and Performance teams, and with our developers and agencies. As a member of the brand's Senior Leadership Team, you will lead the eCommerce function within the brand.

We are looking for someone who does the work rather than directs it, and who can tell us what each change was worth.

What you will do

Trading and commercial performance

Own the weekly trading rhythm: what happened against plan, why, and what you are doing about it

Own the numbers day to day - conversion rate, traffic, sessions, AOV and margin - and act quickly when trading moves off plan

Plan and execute the trading calendar, promotions and launches with the brand and merchandising teams

Keep the site aligned with stock reality: work with merchandising on availability and pricing so we never promote what we cannot supply, and protect brand integrity

Trade our DTC site and third-party channels for performance and profitability

Customer experience and conversion

Run the on-site testing programme - design, build and read A/B tests, act on the results and roll out what wins

Own conversion optimisation across product pages, collection pages, cart and checkout

Merchandise the site day to day: collections, search and discovery, product sequencing, and landing pages for campaigns and launches

Work with tech, ops and our developers/agencies to specify and ship site changes on Shopify - integrations, releases, tracking and technical optimisation - so the site performs seamlessly

Use data and insight to improve conversion, engagement and retention

Search

Develop and deliver the brand's SEO strategy, across traditional search engines and AI platforms

Leadership and collaboration

Lead the eCommerce function within the brand, as a member of the Senior Leadership Team

Align with Marketing, Merchandising, Product and Performance teams so that traffic and conversion goals connect

Drive collaboration and continuous improvement across the eCommerce function and the brand as a whole

Reporting and insight

Own the trading reports and dashboards, and turn them into actionable growth plans

Bring digital retail insight and trends into the business to guide innovation and strategy

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Essential

Proven track record in eCommerce roles, running a site day to day - ideally on Shopify Plus or a similar platform

Real CRO experience - you have run A/B tests, read them properly, and can talk about the ones that failed as well as the ones that worked

Confident in GA4, trading dashboards and site analytics, and able to reach your own conclusions from data rather than reporting it

Hands-on with the platform - you can make changes yourself rather than always briefing someone else

Strong understanding of UX, web design, customer flow and the sales journey

Able to size your work commercially: what changed, what it moved, and what it was worth

Comfortable owning a number and being accountable for it

Excellent communication and stakeholder management across teams and agencies

Helpful

Experience in a DTC business

Knowledge of attribution modelling, website speed optimisation and traffic analysis tools

Experience with merchandising or personalisation tools

Fashion, apparel or another considered-purchase category

title: Marketing Manager
description:
We're recruiting for a Marketing Manager to join a growing and innovative business operating within highly technical markets. This Marketing Manager role sits at the heart of the organisation's growth plans, working closely with sales, product and technical teams to create engaging campaigns, generate demand and strengthen customer relationships. It's an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded Marketing Manager who enjoys combining strategic thinking with hands-on delivery. If you're a results-driven Marketing Manager with strong B2 B experience, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

As Marketing Manager, the successful candidate will lead the development and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns aligned to business objectives, customer needs and target sectors. The role will create compelling content, manage campaign delivery across digital and offline channels, and continually optimise activity to improve performance and results. A key focus will be driving demand generation through content marketing, email campaigns, exhibitions, events and targeted outreach. Working closely with sales teams, the position will ensure marketing activity supports pipeline growth, strengthens customer engagement and contributes to wider commercial objectives. The successful candidate will take ownership of key digital marketing channels, including website performance, SEO, paid media, CRM platforms and marketing automation tools. Responsibilities will include building effective customer journeys, enhancing lead nurturing processes and using data and insight to measure and improve marketing performance. In addition, the role will lead the planning and coordination of industry events and exhibitions, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to maximise engagement, generate commercial opportunities and strengthen the organisation's presence across priority markets.

What experience you'll need to apply
- Degree qualified or equivalent professional experience in marketing or a relevant discipline.
- 6-10 years' marketing experience within B2 B environments.
- Proven success delivering demand generation campaigns that drive measurable business results.
- Experience working within technology, engineering, manufacturing or other technical sectors.
- Strong knowledge of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and analytics.
- Experience managing multi-channel marketing campaigns from planning through to execution and optimisation.
- Strong digital marketing expertise, including website management, SEO, email marketing and paid media.
- Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into actionable improvements.
- Experience collaborating closely with sales teams to support commercial objectives.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and project management skills.
- Proactive approach with the ability to balance strategic planning and hands-on delivery.
- Comfortable working within a fast-paced and evolving environment.

What you'll get in return for your experience

You'll receive a competitive salary + bonus and benefits alongside the opportunity to play a key role in a business that is investing heavily in future growth. You'll have the autonomy to shape marketing activity, influence business performance and work with experienced technical and commercial teams. In return for your expertise, you'll also benefit from ongoing professional development, hybrid working model and flexible working arrangements.

What's next?

If this sounds like the opportunity you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply via the apply button with your latest CV. Alternatively, if you'd like a confidential discussion about this role and whether it could be the right next step in your career, please get in touch with Ania.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Digital Marketing Manager

Location: Bristol

Salary: £45,000 + Benefits

The Opportunity

An established and rapidly expanding international business is seeking a commercially minded Digital Commerce Marketing Manager to take ownership of its online customer proposition and support the continued growth of its portfolio of brands.

Working closely with senior marketing leadership, you will be responsible for managing the day-to-day performance of the group's digital commerce activity, combining commercial insight, campaign management, customer communications and data analysis to maximise online revenue and engagement.

The position would suit a proactive marketing professional who enjoys working across multiple brands and channels and is keen to take ownership of projects within a fast-paced and developing environment.

Key Areas of Responsibility
- Develop and deliver digital acquisition and promotional initiatives designed to improve online revenue, profitability and customer engagement.
- Take ownership of the commercial performance and ongoing development of multiple direct-to-consumer websites.
- Review trading information, customer behaviour and website metrics to identify opportunities for growth.
- Plan and coordinate digital activity alongside wider commercial and sales initiatives.
- Manage the production and delivery of marketing content across relevant digital and customer-facing channels.
- Evaluate campaign results and provide clear performance reporting against agreed objectives.
- Work with external creative, digital and marketing partners, ensuring activity is delivered efficiently, on time and in line with business objectives.
- Maintain and develop customer databases and targeted communication lists.
- Produce regular management reports covering digital performance, campaign activity, website traffic and commercial results.
- Lead the delivery of customer-facing communications, including email marketing, promotional campaigns and supporting marketing materials.
- Work collaboratively with sales teams to develop targeted promotions, offers and dedicated landing pages designed to improve conversion and customer experience.
- Ensure customer data is accurately maintained and managed in accordance with applicable GDPR requirements.
- Analyse consumer sales performance and market trends to support future commercial and marketing planning.
- Monitor digital expenditure and campaign effectiveness, using performance data and emerging trends to identify opportunities for optimisation.
- Use customer and website insight to develop innovative approaches to acquisition, retention and online growth.

What We're Looking For
- Proven experience in a digital marketing, e-commerce or online trading environment.
- Strong commercial understanding of consumer-focused e-commerce.
- Demonstrable experience working with sales and performance data to identify trends and opportunities.
- Practical experience using Google Analytics or comparable digital analytics platforms.
- A strong understanding of digital customer journeys, online conversion and campaign performance.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Strong project coordination and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- A creative and commercially aware approach to developing marketing activity.
- Ideally, a recognised qualification in Marketing, Digital Marketing or a related discipline.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work effectively to demanding deadlines.
- A confident, energetic and solutions-focused approach, with the initiative to take ownership and drive activity forward.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing international organisation where digital commerce is an important part of its continued expansion. You will have the opportunity to work across multiple brands and markets, influence online growth initiatives and develop your career within a business that offers genuine scope for progression.
